title: Typography—Serif: Garamond
slide_intent: Teach designers to give long-form reading a suitable serif face, then create enough separation for the reader to find each heading.
strategic_value: NASA can use Garamond for a publication meant to endure while retaining an option for headings in the agency’s sans serif.
demonstration: The page compares Garamond and Garamond Bold character sets. The lower samples pair Garamond body text with Helvetica Medium headings on the left and Garamond Bold headings on the right.
practical_value: Choose between the two heading treatments. When using Garamond Bold, consider size or surrounding space to make the heading stand out.
